The Shashtiaboorthy Show

Sixty years is a full lap
of the Hindu calendar.

Beginning with Prabhava, Vibhava and Shukla - all the way round and back to Prabhava. A full cosmic cycle of time.

Tamil families treat 60 as a second beginning, not a wind-down.

The first marriage (youth): family building and material life.

The second marriage (spiritual companionship): walking together till the end.

… so welcome to the second marriage.

This Aippasi 26, Parabhava year.

A short life story,
for the latecomers to the show.

24 Nov 1965

It begins

Kamala and Rajagopalan have a son on 24 November 1965. They name him Rajesh, after the hero of Aradhana, hoping he will follow in those steps.

Alas, our hero is hopeless at drama and acting, and no better at mechanics. He can only rote learn - we will eventually find out that he becomes a doctor.

The 1980s

Thanjavur Medical College

Mom was the boss at home
  • Kamala preferred that he stay close to home - Thanjavur Medical College, not Chennai!
  • When the family found out ragging was a possibility, the house moved from Salem to Thanjavur! He became a day scholar.
  • He used to drive his Yamaha bike and apparently he was the fastest biker in the district!
decades later, the ragging stopped. the speeding did not.
ADD PHOTO
1980s · the college years

the last time he was in Texas, he got two speeding tickets two days apart!

1 May 1994

Who was cupid for this match?

JYM Kalyana Mandapam

He - Gen X to the bone. The kind that just works quietly, has a “whatever acceptable” mindset. Less preferences, fewer protests against the parents.

She - “resilience”. A resident in the labour ward, on call the night before the wedding - still found time to marry the next day.

No love, no familiarity, no live-ins - a strange recipe of acceptance, adjustments and a will to make things work

18 / 1,000 divorces amidst Gen X, crazy ain't it?

The firstborn - Jan 1995

Two months later the young bride played truant from residency, claiming sick. They made her do a pregnancy test - and turned the lie into a truth.

Avasarakoduku Aashish arrived ahead of schedule, in Jan 1995.

His every yawn was documented and three entire albums devoted to a boy lying completely still!!! They call it 'first baby syndrome' - no joke.

ADD PHOTO
Jan 1995 · doing nothing really, but camera's ready
Also 1995

After two months of perfecting diaper changes and infant photography, the new mum sat her exams - someone suddenly approved her attendance, oblivious of her maternity leave, a week before her exams!

The paper was punishingly long, and she was the only candidate to finish it, as she did not know enough. She was also the only one who passed!

speed unmatched. method not recommended.

Now she does fertility, and insists:

having a baby before an exam is a fool proof way to pass it!

1998

Abinaya arrives

Second child - everything relaxes! Less camera, the baby book has four lines and then stops - forever.

While objects were sterilised for the first child, by 1998 we figure out that the hydrochloric acid in the stomach can dissolve everything. Nobody panics at a temperature, everything is handed down, and so is a measured quantity of remaining patience. She grew like a wild garden weed - untended, unnoticed. There are more photographs of the 1995 sofa than of Abinaya's first birthday.

In exchange, second children get away with everything. Most would make the trade again.

clearly, she has not let this go
ADD PHOTO
1998 · a rare photo of Abinaya
The middle innings

The greener pastures

Rajesh is working in Dubai. Then Hema is offered a job in Singapore. He drops everything and follows her.

was this love?? today, 9 years of dating comes before the wedding - for them, the wedding came 9 years before the love!
ADD PHOTO
Dubai or Singapore, any year
Every trip

The travelling kitchen

No work trip was taken alone. Aashish and Abinaya attended every gynae conference - and so did an electric cooker.

Vegetarian food in those countries meant boiled vegetables and an apology; baby food meant nothing! So the rice cooker went first into the suitcase, and four people ate puliyodarai in places where their food was not on offer.

Thailand

USA

Rumour has it that the son went on the modern western holidays, and the daughter went to the ones where you offboard the plane onto a bus that drives you to the terminal.

and the cooker has seen more of the world than most people
May 2022

Abinaya marries Raghunathan

Abi and Raghu liked each other after the introduction - but we hadn't checked if the stars aligned yet.

But fret not, we ran through a dozen astrologers until someone said yes. The astrologer quest stops immediately.

What a son-in-law meant for Rajesh: tracking the daily share price of every company Raghu has ever worked for. Raghu would receive Tesla stock articles, employee memos, and market updates - before he even found out internally.

Poor man got these like the Indian good-morning WhatsApps - daily, unsolicited, unstoppable.

the instant dad!
his current employer's stock is not even publicly traded - but the forwards continue.
daily WhatsApp forwards
May 2022 · Abinaya & Raghu
Feb 2024

Aashish marries Niruktha

Aashish is awarded a fellowship and wants to go to Ghana to serve. The family manipulates him into serving in an equally backward corner of India.

This flight miraculously transits at Bangalore, and he meets the prospective Niruktha, who had an evening to spare. The boy and the girl, tired of constant nagging by their families, said yes to each other.

Now Rajesh indulges in his favourite pastime - constant advice, to a wider audience: two sons and two daughters.

if you want to get married quick, don't take direct flights!
ADD PHOTO
Feb 2024 · Aashish & Niruktha
July 2024

Ram arrives

Abinaya and Raghunathan hand over a grandson. Rajesh becomes Thatha.

He then changes more diapers in one year than in the previous fifty-eight. The 1995 edition did not do diapers. The Thatha edition volunteers.

Ram was the apple of the eye surgeon's eye!
July 2024 · enter Ram
12 Nov 2026

Wedding no. 2

One full lap of the Tamil calendar, and he ties the thali for Hema again - same bride, same fire, same known devil.

But there's more of them around now - their children and little Ram running around, the branched-out families of their siblings, the mamas and mamis, chittis and chithappas, the close relatives who gather in times of bliss and distress, and the loving friendships of a lifetime. As their parents once again oversee it all……

some things never change in a lifetime - do they?
this is the bit you are invited to

THE MORNING, IN ORDER

Ninety minutes, one wedding, then lunch.

Homam & muhurtham

10.30 a.m.

The auspicious hour does not negotiate. This will be the one event in your family's history that starts exactly on time. Be seated by 10.20.

The thali gets tied. Again.

Mid-morning

The bit everyone came for. Phones up - but leave a lane for the grandmothers in the front row. They have waited thirty-one years and will not be blocked by your cousin's tripod.

Blessings, photos, mild chaos

12 noon

Elders first, cousins after, and a group photo that takes four attempts because somebody always blinks. Statistically, it is going to be you.
